plugins.name: spug-ops
plugins.description: Spug ops assistant: drive host batch command execution, interactive SSH, file upload/download and deploy status queries through the Spug HTTP API and WebSocket protocol.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 Spug API 与 WebSocket 协议驱动主机批量执行、交互式 SSH、文件上传下载、部署状态查询，内置账号自动续期与目标主机安全确认机制
